description: This Java class 'BankingServiceHelper' provides utility methods for converting between different domain objects and model objects related to banking entities such as Customer, Account, Address, Contact, BankInfo, Transaction, and TransferDetails. It facilitates data transformation for domain separation and data transfer within a banking application.

classes.name: BankingServiceHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing conversion utilities between domain models and persistence models related to banking entities.

methods.name: convertToCustomerDomain
methods.description: Converts a Customer entity object to a CustomerDetails domain object.

methods.name: convertToCustomerEntity
methods.description: Converts a CustomerDetails domain object back to a Customer entity object.

methods.name: convertToAccountDomain
methods.description: Transforms an Account object into AccountInformation domain object.

methods.name: convertToAccountEntity
methods.description: Transforms AccountInformation domain object into an Account entity.

methods.name: convertToAddressDomain
methods.description: Converts an Address object into AddressDetails domain object.

methods.name: convertToAddressEntity
methods.description: Converts AddressDetails domain object into an Address entity.

methods.name: convertToContactDomain
methods.description: Converts a Contact object into ContactDetails domain object.

methods.name: convertToContactEntity
methods.description: Converts ContactDetails domain object into a Contact entity.

methods.name: convertToBankInfoDomain
methods.description: Transforms a BankInfo object into BankInformation domain object.

methods.name: convertToBankInfoEntity
methods.description: Transforms BankInformation domain object into a BankInfo entity.

methods.name: convertToTransactionDomain
methods.description: Converts a Transaction entity into TransactionDetails domain object.

methods.name: convertToTransactionEntity
methods.description: Converts TransactionDetails domain object into a Transaction entity.

methods.name: createTransaction
methods.description: Creates a Transaction object for a transfer, given transfer details, account number, and transaction type.
